name: Time Sensitive and DND-bypass alerts
plain: Marks an alert urgent enough to break through Focus or Do Not Disturb for an hour.
meaning: A way past the person's quiet time. iOS gates it with a capability and lets users switch it off per app; Android gates the equivalent behind Do Not Disturb access.

android.prompt_ui: Settings toggle: Do Not Disturb access
android.revocation: Settings > Notifications > Do Not Disturb access
android.store_policy: Play: restricted to alarm, calling, safety apps
android.note: Bypass works only with DND access granted

ios.prompt_ui: Time Sensitive Notifications toggle per app in Settings
ios.revocation: Settings > Notifications > App > Time Sensitive Notifications
ios.store_policy: App Review 4.5.4: only for urgent events
ios.note: Levels: passive, active, time-sensitive, critical; time sensitive breaks Focus and Scheduled Summary and stays on the lock screen up to 1 hour

limits.headline: Can mark an alert urgent so it breaks through Focus for about an hour
limits.user_action: You allow Time Sensitive in iPhone Settings, or give Do Not Disturb access on Android
can: Show an urgent alert during Focus on iPhone
Stay on the lock screen for about an hour
Break through Do Not Disturb on Android once you grant access
cannot: Break through if you turned Time Sensitive off for that app
Break through the mute switch; that is for Critical Alerts, which need Apple approval
Use Do Not Disturb bypass on Android without your access
limits.reach_label: Urgent alerts only, if you allow
limits.differs: iPhone has four levels and a per app toggle. Android needs you to grant Do Not Disturb access.

story.what_it_is: An alert marked urgent enough to break through Focus or Do Not Disturb for up to an hour.

marketing.name: Time Sensitive notifications
marketing.pitch: Apple lets apps mark an alert as time sensitive so it can break through Focus when it truly matters.

story.for_you: Your phone is quiet in Focus mode, but a delivery arrival or a security alert still breaks through. You can switch this off for any app in Settings.
story.for_makers: Makers get a path past quiet time for things that matter, like a driver at the door. Apple and users limit it because marketing keeps trying to pose as urgent.

use_cases.example: Your driver is outside and the alert breaks through your Focus mode.
A home camera app alerts you to a break in even at night.
A glucose or medication app warns you of a problem during sleep Focus.
Your ride has arrived and the driver is waiting.
A bank flags a suspicious charge you need to confirm now.
A game tries to mark a limited time event as urgent. Apple discourages this.
An airline sends a gate change as time sensitive.

story.android_note: On Android, bypass depends on Do Not Disturb access that you grant in settings.
story.ios_note: iOS has four levels from passive to critical. Time sensitive stays on the lock screen up to an hour.

technical_bounds: Can be switched off by the person

history.change: Interruption levels and Time Sensitive notifications added with Focus
Do Not Disturb access and NotificationManager interruption filter
